prerequisites: compulsory courses of previous semester (Mechanics of Materials)

learning_outcomes.text: To teach the students the advanced tasks and methods applied for the solution of strength and elasticity (i.e. mechanics of materials).
To ensure the understanding of teaching problems.
To apply the gained skills in practice.

syllabus_topics: Combined loadings - space bending, torsion + bending, bending + tension/compression
